summary: Full backend + frontend test of iteration_6 (QR per restaurant + Resend forgot-password). Backend: 26/26 pytest passed including 3 NEW QR tests (test_business_has_qr_fields, test_update_qr_persists, test_update_qr_clear) and existing test_forgot_password (Resend integration responds 200 with API key set). Frontend verified end-to-end at 1920x1080: (1) /settings shows 'QR en cada ticket' card with all 3 testids (qr-config-card, qr-url-input, qr-label-input, save-qr-button); (2) typing URL shows live qr-preview with rendered <canvas>; (3) save persists — reloaded page shows same qr_url + qr_label; (4) completed a sale on /pos with TEST_QR_Cust + TEST_QRTaco $50 cash, .print-area DOM contains exactly 1 <canvas width=128> + the 'TEST_¡Reseña!' label + 'Escanea con tu celular' + 'Gracias' — all confirmed via DOM inspection; (5) reprint-last-button still works post-sale and re-renders QR. Regression: cashier gate (siko/PIN 1234), product cards, cart, checkout modal, payment-cash, auto-print toggle, navigation to /products /orders /stats /cash-register all functional with no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: BusinessUpdate filter `if v is not None` allows clearing qr_url/qr_label by sending '' (empty string) but does NOT allow clearing by sending null — minor inconsistency. Frontend always sends '' so it works.

Receipt.jsx renders QRCodeCanvas inline at fixed position left:-10000px; for large carts the canvas is created on every order — acceptable but could be memoized via React.memo on Receipt for perf if scaling.

buildQrUrl mutates the URL by appending ?ref=<orderid8> — be aware that some Google Reviews short links (g.page) may break when extra query params are added. Consider opt-in toggle for ref-tracking in Settings.
(carry-over) server.py is 854 lines — should be split into routers (auth, business, products, orders, cashiers, stats, cash_register).
(carry-over) POSPage.jsx ~566 lines, still a candidate for splitting CartContent / ProductCard into separate files.

Resend free tier: forgot-password endpoint returns 200 but Resend will only deliver to said95454@gmail.com (the verified account email) until a domain is verified. This is a Resend constraint — the API call itself works. For production, user must verify their domain in Resend dashboard.
